name: weave left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at Drydock, north dock. weave left open. 7 steps. The rope stays for the start.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the rope at Drydock. Nobody past the north dock. We start in 8 steps. Weave on the left lane, open.

name: Drydock north dock
speaker: Bess
line: Drydock north dock. Bess keeps the rope for the start. 2 steps, weave on the left lane, open.
